a.lede: Anti-AI groups gather in front of Nasdaq exchange in Times Square and Anthropic’s headquarters in San Francisco As the artificial intelligence startup Anthropic debuted on the US stock market at an eye-popping $2tn valuation on Thursday, protesters from anti-AI groups rallied in front of the Nasdaq exchange at its New York City headquarters in Times Square and several were arrested.
a.title: Protesters rally against Anthropic in New York and San Francisco after $2tn stock market debut

b.lede: Anthropic's IPO price was set at $83, representing more than $80 billion in new capital raised.
b.title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
